headline: Approved minutes, bills, police invoices, and a $200 donation in memory of Arthur Kahn
summary: The board approved the 2-24-26 meeting minutes, bills and checks for Section 8, MRVP and Revolving Fund registers for January and February 2026, and payment to the Malden Police Department for five invoices. The board also reviewed capital project invoices and change orders for several properties and approved a $200 donation to the Malden DAV in memory of former Commissioner Arthur Kahn. All votes were unanimous roll call votes.
decisions: Approved the 2-24-26 meeting minutes, unanimous (Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis, Emmanuel Marsh, Karin H. Nystrom; Nays: None)

Approved bills and signing of checks for Section 8, MRVP and Revolving Fund Register for January 2026, unanimous (Ayes: William P. Hurley, Joan M. Chiasson, Emmanuel Marsh, Frank M. Molis, Karin H. Nystrom; Nays: None)

Approved bills and signing of checks for Section 8, MRVP and Revolving Fund Register for February 2026, unanimous (Ayes: William P. Hurley, Joan M. Chiasson, Emmanuel Marsh, Frank M. Molis, Karin H. Nystrom; Nays: None)

Approved and authorized payment of $6,073.02 to the Malden Police Department with cost paid by the AMP's served, unanimous (Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis, Emmanuel Marsh, Karin Nystrom; Nays: None)
Approved and authorized a $200.00 donation to the Malden DAV in memory of Arthur Kahn, unanimous (Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis, Emmanuel Marsh, Karin Nystrom; Nays: None)

03/10/26

# THE REGULAR MEETING OF THE MALDEN HOUSING AUTHORITY

The regular meeting of the Malden Housing Authority (MHA) was held on March 10, 2026, at 8:30 AM at the office of MHA, 630 Salem Street, Malden, MA 02148. All votes are by roll call with remote Commissioners.

COMMISSIONERS ATTENDING IN PERSON: Willaim P. Hurley and Karin H. Nystrom

COMMISSIONERS ATTENDING REMOTELY: Frank M. Molis, Emmanuel Marsh and Joan M. Chiasson

MHA STAFF: Stephen G. Finn, Thomas P. Callaghan and Barbara A. Hooley

## 1. APPROVAL OF MINUTES 2-24-26

The Board reviewed the minutes of the 2-24-26 meeting.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by Frank M. Molis, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve the 2-24-26 meeting minutes.

- Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis, Emmanuel Marsh and Karin H. Nystrom
- Nays: None

## 2. APPROVAL OF THE BILLS AND SIGNING OF CHECKS January 2026 and February 2026

a) The Board perused the Section 8 and MRVP Rent Payment Register for January 2026 totaling $1,614,787.82 and the Revolving Fund Register for January, 2026 totaling $646,782.01.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Joan M. Chiasson and seconded by Frank M. Molis, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve the bills and signing of checks for Section 8, MRVP and the Revolving Fund Register for January 2026.

- Ayes: William P. Hurley, Joan M. Chiasson, Emmanuel Marsh, Frank M. Molis and Karin H. Nystrom
- Nays: None

b) The Board analyzed the Section 8 and MRVP Rent Payment Register for February 2026 totaling $1,604,014.90 and the Revolving Fund Register for February, 2026 totaling $929,543.56.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Frank M. Molis and seconded by Emmanuel Marsh, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve the bills and signing of checks for Section 8, MRVP and the Revolving Fund Register for February 2026.

- Ayes: William P. Hurley, Joan M. Chiasson, Emmanuel Marsh, Frank M. Molis and Karin H. Nystrom
- Nays: None

## 9. OPEN DISCUSSION None

a) The Board discussed a donation in the amount of $200.00 to the Malden DAV in memory of past MHA Commissioner Arthur Kahn and remarked on Arthur's contribution to MHA and the community.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Frank M. Molis and seconded by Emmanuel Marsh, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve and authorize donation in the amount of $200.00 to the Malden DAV in memory of Arthur Kahn.

- Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis, Emmanuel Marsh and Karin Nystrom
- Nays: None

b) Malden Mayor Gary Christenson "State of the City" Address on Wednesday, March 18, 2026 at 5:30PM at the Malden Teen Center.
